Name: Record shape, pilot sources and naming-plane join key confirmed
Pilot scope: the two emitting sources and the drift object class

Each adapter's granted permissions compared with its declaration

Name: Records joined on the naming-plane identity plus time for the pilot scope
Unjoinable records counted and reported as a coverage gap
CMDB reconciliation rule applied; unmatched assets worked in the exception queue
Gate 3 — One reconciled picture
Criteria (gates): One reconciled picture for the pilot scope, joined on asset identity, with unjoinable records counted, not dropped

Name: Enterprise groups and administrative units built
